prompt: Check the news for a comprehensive outlook — US, China, Singapore, markets, and important world news. What's new since yesterday?
expected_output: Clustered markdown poll covering all 5 categories (us, china, singapore, markets, important), each story with title + URL + score, cross-feed dedup visible as '(also: ...)', no errors

assertions.name: all_five_category_sections
assertions.description: Output must contain all 5 requested category sections (us, china, singapore, markets, important)
assertions.check: output contains '# us' AND output contains '# china' AND output contains '# singapore' AND output contains '# markets' AND output contains '# important'

assertions.name: story_urls_present
assertions.description: Output must carry source URLs for the stories (at least 20 https:// links)

assertions.name: scores_present
assertions.description: Each rendered story must carry its importance score ('— score N.N')

assertions.name: cross_feed_dedup_visible
assertions.description: Output must show dedup evidence: the same story picked up by multiple feeds rendered once with '(also: ...)' source list

assertions.name: no_crash_output
assertions.description: Output must not contain a Python traceback (per-feed failures must be isolated, not crash the batch)

assertions.name: research_excluded_by_scope
assertions.description: Requested categories exclude research; output must have exactly the 5 requested section headings and no research section (anchored line regex — title words like 'US' must not false-positive)
